legend: Cellular smear comprising syncytial tissue fragments of epithelioid cells with round to oval nuclei and delicate blood vessels in a background of numerous bare nuclei (Giemsa).

legend: A syncytial tissue fragment of spindle to round cells with poorly defined cytoplasm and anisonucleosis. The nuclei are round to oval, with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli (Pap).
source: This image was contributed by Momin Siddiqui, M.D. Cornell Medical School, New York, USA.

legend: Cell block containing a syncytial fragment of epithelioid cells traversed by thin-walled blood vessels. The cells are round to spindle, with poorly defined eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and round to oval nuclei with significant size variation (H&E).
source: This image was contributed by Momin Siddiqui, M.D. Cornell Medical School, New Your, USA.
